fixes: Qualitative sufficient/surplus stock covers plan demand without two-meal or serving-count caps; exact positive stock is also recognized in rough mode; historical aliases use canonical identity matching.
Stock-covered zero-purchase rows are excluded from the rough shopping list. Low bands and expiry insufficient for planned meals still require purchases.

Exhausted or deleted stock is removed from rough snapshot and incremental inventory projections, cooking previews, assistant stock and maintenance ingredient/lot tasks. Legacy zero decimal quantities with residual positive bands are recognized as exhausted.
Obsolete manual cooking controls are removed on background stock refresh while preserving the written record.

Checking a purchase receives outstanding legacy purchases and buys/receives any remaining need in one transaction, preserves current purchase date and sufficient band, without duplicate purchase events. Source/week matching prevents selecting unrelated shopping lines.
historyPolicy: Active removal is logical. Referenced historical rows, undo events and synchronization tombstones remain to protect cooking history and prevent resurrection. No physical cascade purge.
limitations: Isolated SQLite and browser IPC tests; real online two-device, actual model calls and overwrite installation were not performed.
